playbook.name: New Work Assignments
playbook.description: Notifies the user of active sprk_workassignment records created or modified in the last 24 hours on their matters, on matters they own, or that they own. The 24-hour window is fixed (the scheduler passes timeWindowHours=24; the timeWindow parameter is not applied yet). Uses Spaarke custom sprk_workassignment entity (NOT OOB task activity).
playbook.configjson: {"schedule":{"cronExpression":"0 */2 * * 1-5","timezone":"America/Chicago","description":"Every 2 hours on weekdays"},"parameters":{"timeWindow":{"type":"string","default":"24h","options":["12h","24h","48h","7d"],"description":"How far back to look for new assignments"}},"category":"work-assignments","channel":"work-assignments","channelLabel":"New Work Assignments"}

nodes.name: Start
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":33,"scope":"user-matters","resolveUserId":true,"description":"Scoped to current user's matters via LookupUserMembership"}

nodes.name: Lookup My Matters
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":52,"entityType":"sprk_matter","targeting":"people","includeRelated":false,"description":"Resolve the matters FOR the executing user via the people-targeting surface (targeting: people, ADR-034 Amendment A3): records they created (human Created By), are named on (Assigned To, via their linked contact) or personally own — never matters reached only through team, business-unit or organization ownership. Bound to `myMatters.ids` for downstream filtering (the query writes them as <value> children with fetchInGuids)."}

nodes.name: Query New Work Assignments
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":51,"queryMode":true,"entityLogicalName":"sprk_workassignment","fetchXml":"<fetch top=\"50\"><entity name=\"sprk_workassignment\"><attribute name=\"sprk_name\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_workassignmentid\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_workassignmentnumber\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_priority\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_responseduedate\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_assignedto\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_assignedtointernal\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_assignedattorney1\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_assignedparalegal1\"/><attribute name=\"createdon\"/><attribute name=\"modifiedon\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingrecordname\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingrecordurl\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingmatter\"/><attribute name=\"ownerid\"/><link-entity name=\"sprk_matter\" from=\"sprk_matterid\" to=\"sprk_regardingmatter\" link-type=\"outer\" alias=\"m\"><attribute name=\"sprk_mattername\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_matternumber\"/><attribute name=\"ownerid\"/></link-entity><filter type=\"and\"><condition attribute=\"statecode\" operator=\"eq\" value=\"0\"/><filter type=\"or\"><condition attribute=\"createdon\" operator=\"last-x-hours\" value=\"{{timeWindowHours}}\"/><condition attribute=\"modifiedon\" operator=\"last-x-hours\" value=\"{{timeWindowHours}}\"/></filter><filter type=\"or\"><condition attribute=\"sprk_regardingmatter\" operator=\"in\">{{fetchInGuids myMatters.ids}}</condition><condition entityname=\"m\" attribute=\"ownerid\" operator=\"eq-userid\"/><condition attribute=\"ownerid\" operator=\"eq-userid\"/></filter></filter><order attribute=\"createdon\" descending=\"true\"/></entity></fetch>","templateParameters":{"timeWindow":"{{userPreferences.timeWindow ?? '24h'}}"},"description":"Active sprk_workassignment rows (statecode 0) created or modified in the last 24 hours (timeWindowHours; the scheduler passes 24), where (a) sprk_regardingmatter is one of the user's matters (myMatters.ids from Lookup My Matters, written as <value> children by fetchInGuids; an empty list matches nothing), OR (b) the linked matter's owner is the user, OR (c) the assignment's own owner is the user. Newest createdon first, at most 50."}

nodes.name: Has Assignments?
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":30,"condition":{"operator":"gt","left":"{{workAssignmentsQuery.output.count}}","right":0},"trueBranch":"Create Notification","description":"Check if any new work assignments were found"}

nodes.name: Create Notification
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":50,"title":"{{workAssignmentsQuery.output.count}} new work assignment(s)","body":"{{#each workAssignmentsQuery.output.items}}{{sprk_name}} on {{sprk_regardingrecordname}} (due {{sprk_responseduedate}}).\n{{/each}}","category":"work-assignments","priority":200000000,"recipientId":"{{run.userId}}","regardingType":"sprk_workassignment","iterateItems":true,"itemNotification":{"title":"New assignment: {{item.sprk_name}}","body":"{{item.sprk_name}} on {{item.sprk_regardingrecordname}} (due {{item.sprk_responseduedate}})","category":"work-assignments","priority":200000000,"actionUrl":"/main.aspx?pagetype=entityrecord&etn=sprk_workassignment&id={{item.sprk_workassignmentid}}","recipientId":"{{run.userId}}","regardingId":"{{item.sprk_workassignmentid}}","regardingType":"sprk_workassignment","dueDate":"{{item.sprk_responseduedate}}","regardingName":"{{item.sprk_name}}","sourceEntityType":"sprk_workassignment","sourceId":"{{item.sprk_workassignmentid}}","sourceModifiedOn":"{{item.modifiedon}}","sourceOwningUser":"{{item.ownerid}}","viaMatterId":"{{item.sprk_regardingmatter}}","viaMatterName":"{{lookup item 'm.sprk_mattername'}}","viaMatterMembershipsVariable":"myMatters"},"deduplication":{"enabled":true,"key":"work-assignments:{{run.userId}}:{{item.sprk_workassignmentid}}"}}
